Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 16
Reason for Mistake: Misread the October 1949 SS Île de France breakfast menu as not specifying fruit types and focused only on grapefruit juice, overlooking that the menu explicitly includes fruits such as bananas and pears. This faulty verification led to the incorrect conclusion “None,” despite overlap with the painting (pears and bananas).
